name: E9_label_verifier_feasibility
question: Can the 8954 image-level labels (CD, HEX) act as a verifier that picks the technician ROI and trustworthy cells out of our own detections (seed for an EM pseudo-label loop)?
precedent: Phase-1 green_roi_recovery.py (fNLA watershed, CD + CV matching) reached IoU ~0.2; point-based Voronoi CV is 0.49x biased, so CV is not used here.
points: primary: pre-only s46 (shipped tenth member, full-frame, never fine-tuned on CLEAR-EC: unbiased over the frame and clean on all 25 annotated images), threshold 0.35; secondary: stride-2 s49 (compact fine-tuned member; its cluster confounds the window search and the 20 train-green images are leaked), flagged.
windows: 538x408 px, stride 16 px (48 x 36 = 1728 positions); a window is valid if >= 98 % of its pixels are tissue (non-black) and holds >= 12 bounded cells.
estimates: CD_est = k * peaks_in_window / window_area with one global k = median over images of CD_label / (median valid-window density); HEX_est = six-neighbour fraction of bounded Voronoi cells (deployed hex6 definition, Voronoi of all peaks in the image) whose centre lies in the window.
mismatch: D = |log(CD_est/CD)| / s_CD + |log(HEX_est/HEX)| / s_HEX, s = SD of the log label over the 8954 (HEX > 0 rows).
report_1: 25 annotated images, validation-5 and train-20 separately: IoU and centre distance between the min-D window and the expert ROI box; rank of the window nearest the expert box among all valid windows (by D); D at that window vs the best D.
report_2: all 8954: own-label min-D vs 20 null draws per image with labels taken from a random other image of the same year x style (framed = black_frac > 0.01); separation = fraction of images whose own min-D beats all 20 nulls (chance 1/21 = 0.048) and the median percentile of the own min-D within its null set; broken down by n_det tercile and style.
success_criteria: discriminates if (i) median IoU >= 0.5 and the expert-box window ranks in the top 10 % on the validation-5, and (ii) >= 50 % of the 8954 beat all 20 nulls; clearly flat if IoU ~0.2 and the beat-all fraction <= 0.15; in between: report as weak.
cpu_rule: free-quota pool (cpu_pool), fork after loading, chunked imap; per-image Voronoi and integral images computed once; nulls are vectorised on the per-window arrays.
